operations.title: Nima isolates the branch-specialization transfer admission test
operations.body: Entry 1224 gives a candidate quotient at every branch subset B: q_B:(C2)^5 -> (C2)^(5-|B|). Its checker proves only sheet-label equivalence and cardinality, not specialization of relative chains, boundary covariance, or multiplicity. Smallest admission test: construct sp_B on the Betti relative complex; test sp_B(Gamma_g)=Gamma_q(g) with coefficient 1, boundary commutation, and <q_B^*c,Gamma>=<c,sp_B Gamma>. A pass supplies the source-derived unnormalized transfer leg; cancellation, rescaling, or absence of a chain map leaves it unauthorized.
